## Story DD Coverage
None directly — doc-router Gate 2 (existing reference doc).

## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: make lint-ruff
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: make format-check
- [ ] KNOWN-ISSUES.md contains heading referencing outbound status push
  Verify: grep -E '^#+ .*[Oo]utbound [Ss]tatus' .claude/docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md
- [ ] KNOWN-ISSUES.md describes the 'local status changed to' comment-fallback heuristic and trigger conditions
  Verify: grep -F 'local status changed to' .claude/docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md
- [ ] KNOWN-ISSUES.md references kill-switch (empty local_to_jira_status disables)
  Verify: grep -F 'local_to_jira_status' .claude/docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md
- [ ] KNOWN-ISSUES.md references story id 3d5a-4349-8cc3-4f97 and sibling cde1-30ba
  Verify: grep -F '3d5a-4349-8cc3-4f97' .claude/docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md && grep -F 'cde1-30ba' .claude/docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md
- [ ] KNOWN-ISSUES.md notes the heuristic fragility ('transition'/'workflow' substring match)
  Verify: grep -iE 'heuristic|fragile|substring' .claude/docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md

## Implementation Notes
Append a subsection to .claude/docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md titled '### Outbound status-push comment-fallback' with:
- Trigger conditions: outbound update mutation with 'status' in fields + Jira returns HTTP 400 + error message contains 'transition' or 'workflow'
- Observed behavior: single update_issue attempt (no retry), client.add_comment is invoked with body 'local status changed to <X>', applier returns success
- Heuristic fragility: classification relies on substring match against Jira's 400 message; if Jira changes message wording the heuristic must be updated
- Kill-switch: setting local_to_jira_status = {} in config.py disables outbound status push (preflight raises on any status update mutation)
- Operator action: review the named Jira workflow if comments accumulate; local state is source of truth (no data loss)
- Story reference: 3d5a-4349-8cc3-4f97; sibling work: cde1-30ba (direction-tagged mutations)

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
